label: PML::RARA

sections.text: PML encodes the organizer of PML nuclear bodies, which participate in stress and growth-control pathways.
RARA encodes retinoic acid receptor alpha, a ligand-regulated nuclear-receptor transcription factor.

The t(15;17) fusion alters retinoic-acid-dependent transcription, recruits repressive chromatin machinery and disrupts PML nuclear bodies, producing a block in promyelocyte differentiation. It is the defining driver of conventional acute promyelocytic leukemia.
All-trans retinoic acid and arsenic trioxide directly address the PML::RARA disease mechanism and are central to acute promyelocytic leukemia therapy.
